'''1997 Yavin 4 Regionals (Virginia Beach)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Yavin 4 region (Virginia, Washington D.C., West Virginia, Kentucky, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina, Maryland, Delaware).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Yavin 4)
* '''Date:''' 8 November 1997
* '''Site:''' Sci-Con 19, Virginia Beach, Virginia
